'''Little Devil''' is a character in the [[3D Universe]] who is mentioned in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]].

==Character history==
Little Devil is, by [[1992]], a deceased member of the [[Grove Street Families]]. He is mentioned by gang leader [[Sweet|Sean "Sweet" Johnson]] in [[Sweet & Kendl|his first appearance]], and died sometime between [[1987]] and 1992.
